hypothesis: A hard-deadline passive exit or proven same-condition complement-and-merge policy can improve capital-adjusted outcomes for actual Core Carry inventory without worsening tail risk.

universe.decision_time: last actual fill timestamp for the condition
universe.signal_denominator_policy: retain every actual position; missing execution or topology evidence remains an explicit evidence gap

arms.immediate_taker_exit: first full-quantity YES bid ladder within 30 minutes after decision
arms.passive_then_fallback: post SELL one tick inside the ask, wait at most 60 minutes, grant diagnostic fill only after full depth crosses the quote, otherwise sell on first full bid ladder within 30 minutes after deadline
arms.complement_then_merge: buy the exact same-condition NO token on the first full ask ladder within 30 minutes, then merge the complete set; no topology inference is allowed
arms.hold_to_settlement: hold the frozen actual YES inventory to canonical settlement
arms.no_action: current production behavior; under terminal settlement valuation it is intentionally identical to hold_to_settlement

execution.passive_quote: max(best_bid + tick, best_ask - tick), strictly above best_bid
execution.passive_fill_evidence: public full-ladder cross/depth proxy; diagnostic, never actual fill
execution.counterfactual_incentives: 0 unless an immutable realized payout identity exists

economics.terminal_valuation_basis: canonical settlement for hold/no-action; executable cash close for exit/merge arms
economics.capital_time_unit: USD-hour from decision to terminal action
economics.primary: paired economic profit per share versus no_action

inference.pass: paired lower confidence bound exceeds MERE and tail/capacity gates pass
inference.futility: paired upper confidence bound is below MERE
